name: third-party.mcp-inspector
description: Curated provider manifest for the mcp.verify capability.

mcp.verify.fallback: Manual MCP server smoke test using client logs, tool descriptors and explicit test prompts.

install.method: Install and run the upstream MCP Inspector for local MCP server verification.
uninstall: Remove MCP Inspector configuration and any temporary test server credentials.

filesystem: MCP server files selected for inspection
network: Network endpoints exposed by the MCP server under test
permissions.approval: Human approval required before invoking MCP tools that mutate files, external systems or credentials.

transport.notes: Local visual inspector for MCP server transports.

security.notes: MCP tools are model-controlled and can execute with user privileges; sensitive invocations require human approval.

risk.notes: Inspection can expose or invoke tools that access files, networks, credentials or external systems.
